name: anthropic-effective-agents
summary: Distinguishes fixed workflows from agents that direct tools using observations. Recommends starting simple and adding bounded autonomy where it helps.

name: anthropic-context
summary: Curate high-signal context, retrieve relevant information as needed, and persist concise notes rather than replaying all history.

name: anthropic-multiagent
summary: Production research system uses explicit effort budgets, persistence, evaluations and recovery. Its multi-agent costs were substantially higher in its reported workload.

name: langgraph-durable
summary: Persistence separates thread checkpoints from long-term stores. In-memory persistence does not survive service restarts.

name: temporal-ai
summary: Cookbook demonstrates durable agent loops, tool activities, structured outputs, approval signals and hard-rule overrides.

name: cloudflare-patterns
summary: Documents routing, prompt chaining, orchestrator-workers and evaluator-optimizer patterns; relevant patterns can be implemented without moving all orchestration to Cloudflare.
